title: Layoffs Data Cleaning and Modelling Pipeline
summary: Full MySQL cleaning pipeline for a raw layoffs dataset, modelled into a star schema for visualisation.
problem: The raw layoffs dataset contained duplicates, inconsistent text and unparsed dates, so it could not be analysed reliably.
objective: Build a reproducible cleaning pipeline and a star schema ready for visualisation.
approach: Worked in a staging table so the raw data stayed untouched, then cleaned and modelled the data step by step.
process: Engineered features such as percentage laid off
Modelled the cleaned data into a star schema
impact: Shows end-to-end ETL design, data validation and reproducible documentation.
